findings.text: FR-008 requires exit status 1 for missing paths, directories and undecodable input, contradicting the accepted operator clarification and the status-2 contract implemented by the CLI. SC-002 cannot be consistently assessed against this conflicting specification. The actual CLI and passing tests implement approved status 2; changing implementation to status 1 would violate the accepted answer.
findings.suggestion: Use the declared smallest specification correction to restore only FR-008 exit status 2, preserving the accepted clarification, plan, CLI contract, tasks and implementation; then rerun analysis and fresh debrief.
